answer: Every new wallet needs two sponsors in good standing, each escrowing 500 POA for 120 days. Sponsors forfeit the bond when a recruit fails liveness or duplicates a device fingerprint. A fake signup sends a ripple up the graph, burning every bond on it, not one deposit. Seeding 10,000 clones means 20,000 distinct sponsors and 10 million POA locked and slashed within a day of the first cluster failing. Honest members grow slowly, one quill stroke per signature in a shared ledger. Sybil farms build on karst instead, ground that looks solid until one cavern collapses and drops the surface.
